sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified as a calculation-case-to-structural-member relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the supplied nltl:flangeMaterialIncludedInShearArea controlled selection for shear-area treatment: where a flange is fitted, require an explicit boolean branch selection without forcing it to true, while retaining attached shell plating exclusion. The current graph applies net web/attached-plate/flange constraints to every ship structural member independently of a calculation case, so it does not encode the stated applicability ‘when calculating’ and has no path associating a calculation case with the framing member whose inputs are being used.
